headline: Filed a bug? The game now remembers exactly what world you saw
lede: Seed pinning rollout batch 1: eight arcade titles — SSX, Comet Drift (both versions), Smash TV, Short Order Shout, Tempest, Lunar Lander and Lemmings — now attach their world seed to every feedback report and replay it from ?seed=N, joining Gauntlet, QBert and Tetris. A crash you file is a crash QA can re-run on the exact same map.

notes.text: 11 titles total now complete the report+pin seed contract; a feedbackcheck law locks the floor at 11 so the rollout can never quietly regress — mutant-proven (strip a report or a pin and CI goes red).
SSX pins only offline starts: online races keep the lobby's seed so no seat ever desyncs.
Lemmings has zero runtime randomness — its seed is the level you file from, so a report reopens that exact ledge.
Browser-tier proofs still run CI-side: Chrome on the build Mac aborts at a broken launchd service (diagnostic posted on #737) — needs a relogin to heal.
